kind: analyze (structure construction + geometric profile; no DFT)
provenance: profile from 3_reproduction/L2/nu_ac_vs_y.csv and result.json (geometric, paper SM-3 perimeter difference); structure reference POSCAR_R_ac_sin_h9.vasp
sign_convention: nu_ac(y) = (s_top(y) - s_bot(y)) / c_ac, upper layer minus lower layer, the two arc lengths measured from each layer's point on the registered edge y=0 to its point on the mid-surface normal at y. Positive over the whole period. Stated in the prompt; the profile below is graded with this sign.

structure_match.note: translation-only, polarity-safe: the undulated bilayer also absorbs a B/N swap under StructureMatcher; fallback fails swap/mirror/wrong-amplitude. 0.20 A allows the agent's arc-length placement to differ slightly from ours while still pinning the construction.

nu_ac_y0.rule: zero target, graded with an absolute band (a relative tolerance is meaningless at zero); the phase discriminator

nu_ac_max.rule: within 10% relative tolerance, inclusive band 0.6588 to 0.8052

profile_rule: per-point tolerance tol_i = max(0.10*|truth_i|, floor), floor=0.10*max|profile|=0.10*0.73224=0.073224; matched by y_over_L within 0.01. The registered-edge scalar retains its separate 0.0732 band.
score: 1 only if structure, all scalar and profile checks, edge consistency, maximum domination and coincident-sample consistency pass; required data must be valid and each periodic-coordinate group must admit a common value within reporting and arithmetic roundoff. Any failure scores 0.
